"I appreciate all the people who have talked to me about this over the past year. Seriously, its helped a lot. Thank you.  If anyone who was also involved in that situation is reading, I hope youve been well. Im sorry this was stressful for you. Take care of yourself, okay?"

"Ive done my best to change over the past year, and I hope Ive made at least some progress. I dont care about being forgiven. I just want to change, and I feel like Ive grown a lot since this all happened."

"Now, one thing I wanna quick mention before I move onto the next point: I still dont actually know if defending my friend was racist. I talked to so many friends about this if they were okay with it. Many of them are Asian, and said it wasnt."
"But now I know that it doesnt matter if it was racist or not. The important thing is that it wasnt fucking okay. Ignorant, racist, it was still a shitty thing for me to do."
"I know a couple people dont speak for the entirety of one race, but since many of the people who called me out are Asian themselves, I was conflicted about this for so long. I still am."

"I need to apologize about was how I handled the situation. Sure, my mental health was in a poor state at the time, but again, not a fucking excuse. What I shouldve done was calmed myself down, heck, even wait a while, before making any statements."

"I tried to resolve things quickly because I felt horribly guilty for everything I did, but since I never properly calmed myself down, I came across as a guilt tripper because I was beating myself up. Even just taking time to process things couldve changed so much."

"At the time, my current hyperfixation was Mad Rat Dead, and rats in general. I think you can see where Im going with this.  While I never called anyone a rat, I did retweet some pictures of rats to try and calm myself down while this all happened."

"The timing was incredibly poor. I couldve just bookmarked the images and not retweeted them. Having a hyperfixation isnt an excuse to do something that ignorant. That was incredibly insensitive of me to do, and I apologize."

"I cant say if that friend was racist. Im white. That statement about the lead of the team was definitely ignorant, though, yes. But I shouldve waited and gotten all the facts before I formed my opinions on the matter. Im sorry."

"Im not going to talk about what other people did, because thats not important right now. What I need to say is I know that what I did was wrong. Immediately jumping to defend someone when theyre being accused of being racist without getting all the facts is shitty."

"The problem is, the entire situation wasnt handled well. By ANYONE involved. Including me. Nothing ever really came out of the whole thing. There was a lot of yelling and fighting, a lot of blocking, and in the end the whole thing was never really resolved."

"The lead of the localization isnt Japanese, so yeah, theres definitely a hole in that statement. But I ended up defending this person because theyre a longtime friend and I thought instead of jumping to conclusions and labelling them as racist, they should be educated instead."

"Somebody I know was excited for the localization, mainly because it looked like a lot of effort was put into this localization, and it didnt have slurs for shock value like the fan translation did. They were called racist for mentioning that the lead of the team is Asian."

"Racism is not something that should be tolerated. Ever. Even if someone is racist accidentally, they need to be properly educated on why thats wrong and need to acknowledge their mistake so they can do better. But I also shouldve been clear that this person needs educating."
